description: DEFAULT DATA (no rule) for the conflicting-goals goal layer, so the disclaimer analysis auto-fires on an article read WITHOUT a per-analysis teach. Ships ONLY graph DATA: a starter DisclaimerCue codebook (the classic 'not racist but' family -- a stated-goal / hidden-goal tension) and a MethodSpec holding the natural-language method the agent AUTHORS the classify-by-join rule from. The RULE itself is DELIBERATELY NOT shipped here (test_agent_authors_conflicting_goals_rule asserts _no_shipped_conflicting_goals_rule): the only ConflictingGoalsReading rule is the one the agent authors at runtime from this method text via its procedural_reader -> binding_resolver -> method_synthesis faculty (domains/actor_goals.ensure_conflicting_goals_rule). Cues are the agent's held, teach()-extensible data -- teaching a new DisclaimerCue row grows coverage with zero code/rule change.

attrs.name: conflicting_goals
attrs.text: When a disclaimer candidate's phrase matches a disclaimer cue's phrase, classify a conflicting goals reading.
